suggested_requirements.text: The system shall support an administrator level.
The administrator shall be able to create user groups.
The administrator shall be able to create project managers, analysts, and guests.
The administrator shall be able to reset user passwords.
The administrator shall be able to disable access for users.
The system shall support a project manager level.
The project manager shall be able to insert a new privacy policy into the repository.
The project manager shall be able to delete a privacy policy from the repository.
The project manager shall be able to create a new domain of privacy policies.
The project manager shall be able to assign analysts to user groups.
The project manager shall be able to assign user groups and individual analysts to projects.
The project manager shall set restrictions on access to information for guests.
The project manager shall be able to export project data to an XML file.
The project manager shall be able to save the current version of the repository.
The system shall support an analyst level.
The analyst shall be able to select a privacy policy assigned to them.
The analyst shall be able to add, delete, and update goals.
The analyst shall be able to add, delete, and update scenarios.
The analyst shall be able to view details of any goal or scenario in the repository.
The analyst shall be able to update their personal profile.
The analyst shall be able to add, delete, and update requirements.
The analyst shall be able to add, delete, and update access control policies.
The analyst shall be able to view access control policies.
The system shall support a guest level.
The guest shall be able to view information in the repository subject to project manager restrictions.
The system shall allow all users to have different access levels to projects.
The system shall allow secure storage of passwords in the database.
The system shall allow users to securely log onto the system.
The system shall allow analysts to add a new goal.
The system shall provide templates for goals, scenarios, P3P statements, EPAL rules, and access control policies.
The system shall allow analysts to classify goals.
The system shall allow multiple subject classifications for each goal.
The system shall allow the project manager to add a new classification type of goals.
The system shall allow analysts to request a new classification type of goals.
The system shall provide the ability to update an existing goal.
The system shall provide the ability to delete a goal.
The system shall automatically propagate associated policy information upon deletion or replacement of a goal.
The system shall maintain traceability links between a goal and the policy from which it was derived.
The system shall display the number of occurrences of a goal in a policy, multiple policies, and within a domain.
The system shall display the number of different goals that occur in a policy.
